t: The bedouin who asked for something else
a: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا عَبْدُكَ خَرَجَ مُهَاجِرًا فِي سَبِيلِكَ فَقُتِلَ شَهِيدًا أَنَا شَهِيدٌ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
p: Allāhumma hādhā ʿabduka kharaja muhājiran fī sabīlik, fa-qutila shahīdan, anā shahīdun ʿalā dhālik
m: O Allah, this is Your servant. He went out as an emigrant in Your path and was killed a martyr. I am a witness to that.
